result.changelog: Fixed every error item. Ridley is no longer "beaten for good" because he survives to raid Ceres. His wing is "destroyed", forcing a crash landing, as Metroid Wiki says. The Metroid threat is now potential, quoting the manual's "could easily wipe out". Sector 1 (SRX) is separated from the Restricted Laboratory breeding program. Area 6 now holds a Zeta and an Omega with two seals. Autracks fire laser shots, and the "deadliest non-Metroid" superlative on the Diggernaut is gone. I checked each unverified item once. Kept after confirmation: the "small sampling of data" (Wikipedia), the hand-out gesture to the hatchling, the Power Bomb blast of the Diggernaut carcass, and the Area 6 reflooding (from a Wikitroid snippet). Softened or removed: the seal's purple color, icon count and Arm Cannon conduit; the Gamma "sacs"; the "Chozo Robot" alias; the fatal vortex; Gunzoo tracks; Arachnus "kept as a guardian"; Metroid creation in Area 7 stated as fact; "sunlit" and "sandy" areas; and "mostly Gammas". Aeion now comes from the planet and its creatures, not the rock. The Mawkin are no longer co-colonists; they joined the Thoha to contain the Metroids. I re-read the Metroid II manual sentence by sentence: "another research ship", and the notice came from the base. Added: the X overrunning SR388 after the extermination, the Hornoad-mimic infection, the Ceres theft and the hatchling's death before the vaccine, the ten nest larvae with per-area counts adding up to 40, and Super Missiles. Removed the meta phrase "this lorebook prefers", the HUD word "tally" and an unverified Fusion quote. Gated generic keys: the expedition entry is now selective, and the Diggernaut keys are Chozo-prefixed. Dropped the keys "Chozo Robot", "last Metroid" and "Chozo lab(s)". Trimmed cross-references and converted the labs entry to prose. Word counts are 499, 383, 527, 372, 399 and 385.
result.unresolved: Area-by-area details and the Diggernaut fight rest on a fan walkthrough (omegametroid.com) and Wikitroid search snippets, because Metroid Wiki has no Diggernaut, Chozo Seal or area pages. Whether the teleporters' official name is "Teleport Station" or "Teleportal" is unconfirmed, so a generic word is used. That the hatchling drained Ridley's energy to save her and the Area 1–7 item placements were not flagged by the fact-checker, but I did not re-check them. Where the Thoha massacre took place is not stated in any source, so it is not asserted. The mission entry (527 words) and the planet overview (499 words) use the larger budget allowed for the biggest subjects.
